scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm:release && tsc && vite build
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --profile release --features bevy/webgpu --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --out-dir wasm --out-name main --target web target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/bevy-webgpu.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:release: cargo build --profile wasm-release --features bevy/webgpu --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --out-dir wasm --out-name main --target web target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm-release/bevy-webgpu.wasm && wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext --enable-mutable-globals -o wasm/main_bg.wasm wasm/main_bg.wasm
